title: audit-log-exporter: wire S3 + BigQuery export sinks & retention config for Private (Helm + Terraform + installer)
author: Aisha Thompson
release_notes: Adds wiring for audit-log-exporter to support S3 and BigQuery sinks in Private installations; configurable retention windows and upgrade hooks. No breaking changes to existing Helm values; Helm hooks added to support smooth upgrades and rollbacks.
description: Motivation: Private customers need audit export sinks and configurable retention for compliance. This PR wires the audit-log-exporter into the Private installer and Terraform modules, exposes retention and sink config through Helm values, and adds upgrade/rollback hooks to avoid export downtime. Scope: 1) Helm chart changes: new values.auditLogExporter.{enabled,retention_days,s3,bigquery,kms} with sensible defaults (retention_days=90). Added pre-upgrade/post-upgrade hooks to ensure exporter rollout before switching sink configs. 2) Terraform: module 'private_audit_export' that provisions S3/BQ glue wiring when using the Private installer, accepts KMS key ARN for envelope encryption and IAM role ARNs for cross-account sinks. 3) Installer wiring: installer templates call Terraform module and populate Helm values via the installer config. 4) Migration/upgrade path: DB migration job for existing installations to create default retention policy and migrate existing sink config; rollback path documented and implemented via Helm hooks. Checklist: - [x] Helm values, templates, and hooks - [x] Terraform module and example usage - [x] Installer wiring and integration tests - [x] KMS and IAM handoff with clear documentation - [x] E2E smoke on private-kind environment - [x] CI + chart linting updated Backwards compatibility: defaults keep current behavior unchanged for customers who do not enable the new sinks. Security: KMS integration and least-privilege IAM roles are required for cross-account sinks. Testing: unit tests for template rendering, terraform plan snapshots, and an e2e smoke that validates a synthetic audit event is exported to a test S3 bucket and BigQuery dataset when enabled.

notes_for_operators: Upgrade notes: helm pre-upgrade hook runs a dry-run of sink switching; ensure Terraform run has correct KMS and IAM role ARNs. If you rely on cross-account sinks, confirm the target account's bucket/dataset permissions before enabling. To rollback, use 'helm rollback' which will trigger the post-rollback hook to reapply previous sink configs. Default retention is 90 days; to change, set values.auditLogExporter.retention_days and reapply the chart.
incident_links: SUP-88: customer reported missing exports in private deployment; root cause was missing installer wiring for retention and sink config
security_considerations: KMS customer-supplied key ARN supported. Module will not create keys by default. Cross-account sink requires explicit IAM role ARNs; sample least-privilege policy included in examples. Audit exporter logs sensitive metadata—ensure log redaction pipeline upstream if required.
testing_notes: Unit: template rendering and terraform plan snapshot. Integration: private-kind cluster + local terraform to provision test S3 and BigQuery test dataset. Smoke validates a synthetic audit event travels through the exporter and appears in S3 and BQ. CI includes retries for flaky helm lint step.
